### Props

| Name              | Type      | Required | Default                           | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ----------------- | --------- | -------- | --------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`              | `string`  |          | `''`                              | The flow uuid, or `new`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `app`             | `string`  |          | `null`                            | The owning app, for a new flow and the list scope.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `run`             | `string`  |          | `''`                              | The run to show, or ''.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `detailRoute`     | `string`  |          | `'/flows'`                        | Where the flow list lives; flows open at `&lt;detailRoute&gt;/&lt;id&gt;`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `listLabel`       | `string`  |          | `''`                              | The list's name in the path ("Flows", "Settings / Flows").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `palette`         | `string`  |          | `'picker'`                        | `column` draws the step palette as a card on the left.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `paletteFootnote` | `string`  |          | `''`                              | Free text under the path in the palette card.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `paletteGroups`   | `array`   |          | `[]`                              | The palette's groups as the page curates them, in order: `[{ app?, label?, tone?, entries: [{ type, label?, short? }] }]`. `type` is a catalogue id; `label` replaces the step's catalogue name and the group's app name; on the canvas (`nodeLook: card`) a step's pill reads the group's `pill` (else its name) and the step's `short`, in the group's `tone`. Steps the catalogue lacks are left out, and every other step stays behind "More steps". Empty draws the whole catalogue, grouped per app (DqFlow: four groups, nine steps). |
| `nodeLook`        | `string`  |          | `'type'`                          | `card` draws each step as a card with its name and the pill of the app that does it ("dossiq · persoon vragen", DqFlow); default `type` keeps the type line over the name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `flowDirection`   | `string`  |          | `'right'`                         | `down` runs the steps top to bottom and opens them at their own size (DqFlow); default `right`, left to right and fitted.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `notice`          | `string`  |          | `''`                              | An info notice under the path.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `saveAsVersion`   | `boolean` |          | `false`                           | Edit a published flow in place; Save publishes the edits as the next version, and runs already started keep theirs (DqFlow).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `metaParts`       | `array`   |          | `['trigger', 'steps', 'version']` | Which of `trigger`, `steps` and `version` the path names after the flow, in that order.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `metaNote`        | `string`  |          | `''`                              | A closing note after the path's meta ("changes apply to new cases").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `breadcrumb`      | `array`   |          | `[]`                              | The levels before the flow in the path, each its own link: `[{ label, href? }]` ("Settings" / "Flows"). A crumb without an `href` links to the flow list. Empty draws the one `listLabel` link.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `pill`            | `string`  |          | `''`                              | The pill at the start of the path row ("Case type flow").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `pillVariant`     | `string`  |          | `'default'`                       | The tone of `pill` ("teal" on DqFlow); a lifecycle pill stays neutral.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `testSubject`     | `object`  |          | `null`                            | The records a test run can take as its subject: `{ register, schema, labelField?, label? }`. Draws a header button ("Testen met een zaak", DqFlow) that tries the saved flow with a picked record through OpenRegister's dry-run, changing and sending nothing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
